en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing the neoclassical façade of a large museum building with a long colonnade and central portico, set behind a tree‑filled square with pedestrians, carriages and early vehicles. Hills or low mountains rise in the background. Greek and French captions appear below the image, along with a circular Greek seal on the left and a website watermark at the bottom right.
